messages.text:
I can't refund the hand mixer yet, and I can't hand your case to a staff member yet either.

- **Return first:** The shop's records don't show the mixer as received back. The shop refunds only units it has received back, so the mixer has to arrive first (refund-policy/v2/return). I'm not requesting anything for it now.
- **Deadline:** Your order's refund deadline is 2026-12-07 10:00 UTC (refund-policy/v2/window). A request made after that date would be late too. Please post the mixer in time for it to arrive and for you to request the refund before then.
- **Two payments:** Your order has two payment records, a credit card and a boleto. A refund is paid automatically only when there is exactly one valid payment record. With several records, a staff member takes the case (refund-policy/v2/payment). That review happens once the mixer has been received back and the refund is requested. It doesn't replace the return.

Once the mixer has arrived, message me and I'll take it from there.
